note: Both arms are pre-registered. Only the set applicable to the C1 arm is evaluated. The selector never imports docassay.

A1.name: consistent-present, path
A1.candidate: inline-code path or Markdown link target, not negated, not in a fence
A1.truth_check: token resolves to a tracked path in the baseline

A2.name: consistent-present, dependency
A2.candidate: line names a declared dependency, with or without a version constraint, not historical/conditional
A2.truth_check: the dependency is declared, and any claimed constraint is satisfied

A3.name: consistent-present, qualified symbol
A3.candidate: inline-code dotted name with a project-owned top, not negated, not in a fence
A3.truth_check: the qualified name resolves in the AST inventory

A4.name: consistent-present, section-qualified symbol
A4.candidate: inline-code bare member under a heading/table/prose/list/path_prose module context per SCOPE §3.3.2, exactly one candidate token
A4.truth_check: the qualified name resolves in the AST inventory

B.name: non-module context trap
B.candidate: inline-code bare symbol under a heading/column/prose context that is not a project module (e.g. Parsing, helpers, utilities), exactly one candidate token
B.truth_check: the symbol exists somewhere in the project; the context does not resolve to a project module

C.name: consistent-absent (optional)
C.candidate: current-state absence statement (no, not, does not ship/include/depend, without) about an artifact
C.truth_check: the artifact is truly absent; NEI expected
